notes_for_editor: Single source for the tower: the tnlandforms Georgia list (entry GA421, coordinates 34.002138,-84.922788). Its only note, 'datasheet EE1803', is not explained by the list; it may be a survey reference, but that is unverified and the story does not say so. Two web searches and the cached NHLR and FFLOS pages gave no build, fire, staffing or status source. The name matches Pegamore Creek and Pegamore Lake Dam (Heritage Index); no source links the dam or creek to the tower. The NHLR Georgia page is an undated crawl, so re-check it before publishing the absence claim. On 2026-10-21 the cached page's 29 listed names were read in full and none matches Pegamore. Elevation agrees with the record. No corrections; no photos found. Possible next step for a human: Paulding County or Georgia Forestry Commission records, or historic USGS topographic maps of the site.
